updates.request: Every new animation must work across different fighter skeletons, bone counts, rest poses, missing joints, rotating/special moves, back-turned moves, and attacker/receiver pairs without one-off fixes.
documented_facts: Brutal Fist now has a universal intake branch with canonical bone aliasing, source-rest to target-bind conversion, explicit rest tracks for missing target bones, multi-body rejection, non-finite/frozen gates, and model-aware source recovery.
AnimationController uses fixed authored timing without Three.js time-warping during crossfade.
Grapple is a real one-shot state.
Baked motion already carries measured semantic, airborne, receiver, pairedWith, body-count, strike reach, facing, spine-up, floor-gap and moving-bone metadata.
Unknown/uncertified animation is never promoted as PASS.
Runtime visual certification remains separate from static bake safety.
updates.next_required_pipeline: source provenance -> skeleton inspection -> canonical alias map -> source-rest/target-bind conversion -> missing-joint rest fill -> root/facing/floor normalization -> body-count/receiver detection -> semantic classification -> joint/limb/contact gates -> combat timing -> per-model runtime visual certification -> promotion into moveset library.

documented: Different bind/rest conventions, including T-pose versus A-pose.
Missing target tracks causing bones to inherit the previous move unless explicit rest tracks are filled.
Receiver halves accidentally routed as attacker clips.
Multi-body/tag captures collapsed onto one fighter.
Clips that rotate/turn the body partway through the action.
Frozen/statue clips and clips with too few moving bones.
Upside-down or floor-contact clips misclassified as standing attacks.
Strike direction judged from peak speed instead of actual reach.
Long demonstration clips used as single combat attacks.

facts: public/motion/baked/index.json records HURRICANE_KICK as airborne attack_2, duration 1.8333s, but its strike geometry has negative foot reach and its measured motion was identified as a one-bone/hips-dominated statue spin.
The previous routing was therefore frozen/rejected rather than pretending it was safe.
The desired repair is to restore the visual rotating-kick behavior through a real rotation-aware special-move lane, not to revive the known-bad bake blindly.
updates.future_rule: Spinning attacks get a dedicated rotation/root-travel contract: preserve authored yaw/whole-body rotation when certified, separate root displacement from local limb motion, and verify opponent-facing/contact at impact.

facts: God Within is documented as a New Game Plus, canon-adjacent game mode shaped after Book 3 Ch.31-40 with Onyx as a game-only cultivator of Maime.
Marquis, Bannon and Maime are documented as three fightable persona states of one man rather than three separate characters.

Book 5 establishes The Island / Neon Olympus, Shinobi/Jaleel's AR-controlled wrestling world, the Resistance/Core Unlocked, The Crash War Games, the Warlord Era after the EMP, and the rise of The Administration.

Book 6 continues Books 3-5 as binding canon and adds the Mayan Title Belt, The Temple at Boyle Heights ruins, NWC, The Outsiders, The Cabinet, D-Generation Sex, The Coven, and The Algorithm/New Breed.
God Within's game-only stable is Onyx, CIPHER, ECHO, HOLLOW and STATIC; the repository explicitly separates them from the six-book canon.

sources: Quaternius Universal Animation Library 1: 120+ universal-humanoid animations, CC0.
Quaternius Universal Animation Library 2: 130+ universal-humanoid animations, CC0.
Current Brutal Fist repository contains baked UAL1/UAL2 JSON/Zstd outputs and an open-animation intake/fetch/sync lane.
The public standard/free distributions are treated as intake sources; paid/proprietary source packs are not silently vendored.
updates.engineering_note: The source packs have both in-place and root-motion variants in current public distributions. The pipeline must keep those variants explicit instead of mixing root travel into the fighter's world transform.

facts: Latest Brutal Fist CI run 36459115946: Typecheck PASS, Tests PASS, compatibility build PASS, Production build PASS, Rocket production build PASS, Chromium install PASS, PWA start PASS.

The real portrait playtest failed: arena ready NO, 0 skinned rigs, 144 page errors, 40 failed requests, 6 attacks started from 6 presses, and the harness ran at about 2.3 fps with 56 frames over 120ms.
The failed requests included missing root /motion/TPOSE.json, /motion/SPINJUMP*.json and many UAL1 source-name JSON paths even though corresponding baked UAL outputs exist under public/motion/baked.
This is now a concrete production blocker: asset loading and core-animation startup must be fixed before claiming the PWA is playable.
